acceptance.given: Pinned semantic-result evidence and its diagnostic-category set are available, and the original binding identity has been reconstructed exactly before replay.

oracle.expected: Machine-verifiable replay receipt shows the fresh diagnostic-category set equals the pinned set under the same reconstructed binding identity.
forbidden: Diagnostic categories differ while the result is reported as reproduced.
Diagnostic categories are inferred from labels or prose without replay evidence.
oracle.observable: Fresh replay receipt contains canonical binding identity plus pinned and fresh diagnostic-category sets and an equality check.

acceptance.then: The replay result is accepted as semantically reproduced only when diagnostic-category equality is evidenced.
acceptance.when: During runtime evaluation of the fresh replay after identity reconstruction, compare machine-recorded fresh diagnostics with the pinned diagnostics.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Alter the fresh replay diagnostic category set while keeping the pinned set and binding identity unchanged; the equality check must fail.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Reconstruct the original binding identity, replay with that same identity, and require machine-verifiable equality between pinned and fresh diagnostic categories before semantic reproduction succeeds.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve existing replay receipt fields and fail closed when diagnostic equality or binding identity is absent.

slice_hint.state_transition: pinned result -> reconstructed identity -> same-identity fresh replay -> diagnostic-category comparison -> reproduced or failed
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Terminal success requires same binding identity and exact pinned/fresh diagnostic-category equality; otherwise terminal failure.

acceptance.given: A Matrix run declares all required Matrix Case inputs and both subject executions.

oracle.expected: Aggregate evaluation emits a failed result and invalid aggregate status whenever any required Matrix Case input or subject execution is missing.
forbidden: Aggregate passes despite missing required execution coverage.
Missing Matrix Case execution is ignored.
oracle.observable: Aggregate receipt lists required executions, observed executions, computes coverage completeness, and reports failure when incomplete.

acceptance.then: The aggregate is accepted only with complete required execution coverage; any omission yields failure.
acceptance.when: During matrix aggregate evaluation, reconcile the required execution set against recorded executions before computing success.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Remove one required Matrix Case subject execution from the evidence set while leaving declarations unchanged; aggregate evaluation must fail.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Compute aggregate success only after exact reconciliation of all six Matrix Cases and both subject executions; incomplete coverage is terminal failure.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Retain aggregate receipt schema; missing coverage must map to existing unsuccessful terminal categories.

slice_hint.state_transition: declared matrix set -> execution reconciliation -> complete aggregate or coverage failure
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Aggregate terminal success is impossible unless every required case/subject execution is present and attributable.

acceptance.given: A detached negative Probe is launched with a declared malformed input and its process dependencies and execution environment are intentionally made to produce an infrastructure failure.

oracle.expected: The Probe outcome is failed as an infrastructure execution failure, and no successful negative-validation result is emitted.
forbidden: Infrastructure failure is reported as a passing negative Probe.
A missing dependency, timeout, or non-start is treated as proof of validator rejection.
oracle.observable: Probe receipt records process start/exit or timeout diagnostics and classifies the infrastructure-failure false negative as failed.

acceptance.then: The detached negative Probe remains unsuccessful and is excluded from successful discrimination evidence.
acceptance.when: At runtime, inspect the real Probe process outcome and classify infrastructure failures before applying the malformed-input oracle.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the detached negative Probe with a dependency or launcher failure and assert the receipt is failed rather than a passing rejection.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Classify infrastructure-failure false negatives as failed Probe outcomes, distinct from the declared malformed-input diagnostic failure.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Preserve Probe receipt result categories and ensure infrastructure failures cannot satisfy negative Probe success.

slice_hint.state_transition: negative Probe launch -> process observation -> infrastructure classification -> failed Probe terminal state
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Any infrastructure failure yields failed Probe outcome and no successful negative discrimination evidence.

acceptance.given: An aggregate evaluation contains matrix evidence records whose identity or provenance indicates that evidence was reused across required Matrix Case executions.

oracle.expected: Structural aggregate validation marks the aggregate invalid and prevents acceptance when reused matrix evidence is detected.
forbidden: Aggregate remains valid or accepted despite reused matrix evidence.
Evidence reuse is hidden by relabeling or duplicate labels.
oracle.observable: Aggregate validation artifact enumerates reused evidence identities/provenance and emits an invalid aggregate verdict during matrix evaluation.

acceptance.then: The aggregate cannot transition to accepted while any matrix evidence is reused.
acceptance.when: During aggregate evaluation, perform provenance/identity uniqueness checks over matrix evidence before terminal verdict calculation.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Duplicate one matrix evidence identity across two required cases and verify structural validation emits invalid aggregate status.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Detect reused matrix evidence by identity/provenance and invalidate the aggregate before acceptance, even when labels and counts appear complete.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: Keep aggregate and evidence receipt compatibility; add fail-closed invalidation for duplicate/reused evidence identities.

slice_hint.state_transition: matrix evidence collected -> identity/provenance uniqueness check -> valid aggregate or invalid aggregate
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: Aggregate acceptance is forbidden whenever any matrix evidence identity is reused across cases or subjects.
